comment: F9 — the demo claim as a test, never-drop. need_on runs live; need_off BRANCHES from its log at tick 4 with scripted needs and goal waves switched off. Branching rather than re-running is the point: the twin inherits the parent's actual first four days of history, so the only thing that differs afterwards is whether goals exist. Ticks 14 so the post-divergence window is 10 days — long enough for a need to activate, be carried down the funnel and be satisfied. SIZED 2026-08-20: an extra wave (x6 on 5504, the hero product's category, for the whole run) amplifies exactly the channel under test. It only applies to the need_on arm: goal_step gates extra_waves on waves_enabled, which need_off switches off. Base arrival rates still run in BOTH arms, so need_off is 'no wave-driven demand', not 'no demand' — which is why goal_stats' within-run split is the undiluted statement of the claim and the cross-arm ratio is the conservative one.
